rationale: The preregistered critical-gap rule rejects every window containing the 36-hour Kraken BTC/EUR gap. The amendment removes only those three market windows across all four cost profiles and preserves every other exploratory and confirmation window.
disclosure: Exploratory windows containing the documented 36-hour Kraken BTC/EUR gap in January 2018 were excluded before interpretation; no price values were interpolated or sourced from another venue.
